Locale codes. Most are ISO-639 codes; the site also serves dialects and contact languages with custom codes: hrk = Hunsrik (German-Brazilian dialect), cas = Rioplatense Spanish, riv = Portuñol (Uruguay/Brazil border), gn = Guaraní, tln = Talian (Italian-Brazilian dialect), gl = Galego, ca = Català, ga = Gaeilge. PT/HRX/TLI are legacy aliases kept so old URLs still resolve to a locale.
